ram_mode.fact: The branch compares component kind with 0x76 (118).
The option-building loop starts at 0, continues while index <= 0, increments once, and therefore builds only indices 0 and 1.
The preview index is min(option_count - 1, settings[0]); an unknown value 2 is display-clamped to the final legal entry only.
config_listbox_ram_mode.c:134 initializes the return value to -1; lines 462-467 replace it only when igSelectable_Bool reports a click.
The panel skips set_setting when the listbox result is negative; only a real selection writes settings[0].

ram_depth.fact: The depth UI is entered only when settings[0] is exactly 1; value 2 skips the control.
The depth listbox writes settings[1] only when its return value is nonnegative.
